stem.text: Two forces act on a circular disc as shown.

stem.alt: Circular disc with a 3 N force arrow pointing up from its top edge and a 4 N force arrow pointing right from its centre.

stem.text: Which diagram shows the line of action of the resultant force?

A.alt: Circle with a dot on the top edge and a dot at the centre; a 5 N arrow starts at the centre and points up and to the right.

B.alt: Circle with dots on the top edge, above the centre and at the centre; a 5 N arrow starts at the upper inner dot and points up and to the right.

C.alt: Circle with a dot on the top edge and a dot at the centre; a 5 N arrow starts at the centre and points up and to the right.

D.alt: Circle with a dot on the top edge and two dots on the same horizontal line near the centre; a 5 N arrow starts at the right-hand dot and points up and to the right.
